content.short: Singapore firm building AgentX, which gives AI agents financial skills and compliance checks.
content.description: MetaComp works on the overlap between traditional finance and digital assets. Its main product, AgentX, equips AI agents with pre-built financial skills so they can read transactions, assess risk and act within real financial systems, with compliance checks built in. Developers connect it through MCP, a CLI, skills or a REST API, and it is designed for agent-to-agent discovery and settlement.
content.meta: MetaComp's AgentX gives AI agents financial skills and compliance, available through MCP, CLI and API.
